conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Which method do you think is more reliable for understanding our thoughts?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Both methods offer unique insights; neuroimaging provides objective data, while self-reporting offers subjective experiences. They complement each other rather than one being definitively "more reliable" overall.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. It's interesting how different approaches can give us a fuller picture.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
